race.comment: DYNAMIC LEGEND (5) resumes as the runner with the most appealing profile, having shown enough in two provincial/metro runs last preparation to be highly competitive in this. Her Hawkesbury sixth reads better than the margin after covering ground throughout, and the earlier Canterbury fourth on heavy ground gives the form some substance. Bright start anticipated. RUM AND KIRK (2) is the race-fit danger, with a Coffs Harbour placing on soft ground and a forgivable Grafton fourth after being bumped and reported lame. Is another that can make an immediate impact in the new colours. VINCENTVANGEE (1) closed off well for second at Cairns after early trouble, though the wide barrier and top weight are considerations. HURKLE DURKLE (9) resumes with some prior placing form and comes back from provincial company. Debutant GLOBAL ENERGY (6) was a dominant trial winner in readiness and warrants a market watch.
